summary: Rocket One Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that it received a Nasdaq notification confirming it regained compliance with the minimum bid price requirement (Rule 5550(a)(2)). The company's common stock closed at or above $1.00/share for ten consecutive business days (June 9–23, 2026). No board recommendation, advisor, or structural changes were disclosed. This is a routine compliance update with no special-situation transaction or material corporate action. The filing does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, or any event warranting a special-situation classification.
